Stop Doing Free Work. The Unassailable Defense Against Client Scope Creep & Unpaid Invoices. Includes the Emergency Unpaid Invoice Recovery Engine (UCC § 2-209 Fast-Track Protocol).

Autonomous Scope Creep Auditor, Billable Hours Variance Calculator & Statutory UCC § 2-209 Change-Order Generator.
Built for Digital Agencies, Freelance Engineers, and Software Studios to eliminate unpaid dev work.

🏢 Enterprise & Agency Enforcer (Lock Entire Team's Repo)

To enforce scope protection across your whole development agency and block junior developers from leaking unpaid client hours:

# 1. Install Pre-Commit Scope Shield directly into any Git repo:
npx scopelock-audit --install-hook

# 2. Inspect Agency Pro Tier ($199/mo) & CI/CD Protection:
npx scopelock-audit --agency

👉 Live B2B Portal & Patreon Gateway ($199/mo): https://ahirwardhanmanti83-bit.github.io/scopelock-ai/agency-enterprise.html

⚡ 10-Second Quickstart (Zero Install)

Run the autonomous scope auditor directly in your project root using NPX:

npx scopelock-audit

Or run directly in any Git repository to scan staged/uncommitted files:

npx scopelock-audit --scan

📥 What It Does:

  1. Scans Git Diff & Source Code: Automatically identifies unbilled feature requests, out-of-scope architectural refactors, and creep keywords ("just quickly add", "can you also support", "should only take 5 mins").
  2. Calculates Financial Bleed: Converts extra developer hours into dollar variance at standard commercial rates ($125/hr default).
  3. Generates Binding UCC § 2-209 Change Orders: Produces court-admissible commercial change orders with unilateral stop-work protection clauses before unbilled code is delivered.

🌐 24/7 Live Web Dashboard

Visit the permanent production portal hosted on GitHub CDN:
👉 https://ahirwardhanmanti83-bit.github.io/scopelock-ai/

  • Interactive Scope Scanner: Paste Slack, WhatsApp, Upwork, or Email client messages to get an instant scope-creep verdict.
  • Margin Bleed Calculator: Visualize how a 10-hour feature creep reduces agency net margins from 40% to -15%.
  • Client Change-Order Generator: 1-Click export to clean legal notice or PDF.

🛡️ Git Pre-Commit Hook (Automated Scope Freeze)

Freeze scope creeps before code can even be committed to GitHub:

npx scopelock-audit --install-hook

This installs .git/hooks/pre-commit in your repository. When engineers try to commit files exceeding planned scope without an attached change order, the commit is safely paused.

📦 GitHub Actions CI/CD Integration

Enforce scope locks across pull requests automatically in your workflow .github/workflows/scopelock.yml:

name: ScopeLock Creep Audit
on: [pull_request]

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Audit Scope Creep
        uses: ahirwardhanmanti83-bit/scopelock-ai@main
